units.text: е) general matters of upbringing, education, science, culture, physical culture and sport, and youth policy;
units.label: Point «е» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: ж) coordination of healthcare matters, including ensuring accessible and high-quality medical care, preserving and improving public health, creating conditions for healthy lifestyles and for developing a culture of responsible attitudes by citizens towards their health; social protection, including social security;
units.label: Point «ж» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: ж.1) protection of the family, motherhood, fatherhood and childhood; protection of the institution of marriage as a union of a man and a woman; creating conditions for the proper upbringing of children in the family and for adult children to fulfil their duty to care for their parents;
units.label: Point «ж» Part 1 Art. 72 · “ж.1) protection of the family, motherhood, fatherhood and…”

units.text: з) implementing measures to combat disasters, natural calamities and epidemics and to eliminate their consequences;
units.label: Point «з» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: и) establishment of general principles of taxation and levies in the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «и» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: к) administrative, administrative procedural, labour, family, housing, land, water and forest legislation, and legislation on subsoil and environmental protection;
units.label: Point «к» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: л) personnel of judicial and law-enforcement bodies; the bar and the notariat;
units.label: Point «л» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: м) protection of the traditional habitat and way of life of small-numbered ethnic communities;
units.label: Point «м» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: н) establishment of general principles for organizing the system of bodies of state authority and local self-government;
units.label: Point «н» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: о) coordination of the international and foreign economic relations of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and implementation of international treaties of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point «о» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: 2. The provisions of this Article apply equally to republics, territories, regions, cities of federal significance, the autonomous region and autonomous areas.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 72

units.text: Article 73
units.label: Art. 73

units.text: Outside the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and its powers in matters of joint jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and its constituent entities, the constituent entities of the Russian Federation possess the full extent of state power.
units.label: Art. 73 · text

units.text: Article 74
units.label: Art. 74

units.text: 1. Customs boundaries, duties, levies or any other obstacles to the free movement of goods, services and financial resources may not be established within the territory of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 74

units.text: 2. Restrictions on the movement of goods and services may be introduced in accordance with federal law if necessary to ensure security, protect people's life and health, or protect nature and cultural assets.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 74

units.text: Article 75
units.label: Art. 75

units.text: 1. The monetary unit of the Russian Federation is the rouble. Currency is issued exclusively by the Central Bank of the Russian Federation. The introduction and issuance of other currencies in the Russian Federation are not permitted.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 75

units.text: 2. Protecting and ensuring the stability of the rouble is the principal function of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, which it performs independently of other bodies of state authority.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 75

units.text: 3. The system of taxes levied for the federal budget and the general principles of taxation and levies in the Russian Federation are established by federal law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 75

units.text: 4. State loans are issued in the manner determined by federal law and subscribed to on a voluntary basis.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 75

units.text: 5. The Russian Federation respects citizens' labour and ensures protection of their rights. The State guarantees a minimum wage not lower than the subsistence minimum for the working-age population of the Russian Federation as a whole.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 75

units.text: 6. In the Russian Federation, a pension system for citizens is formed on the principles of universality, fairness and solidarity between generations, and its effective functioning is maintained; pensions are also indexed at least once a year in the manner established by federal law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 75

units.text: 7. In the Russian Federation, compulsory social insurance, targeted social support for citizens, and indexation of social benefits and other social payments are guaranteed in accordance with federal law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 75

units.text: Article 75.1
units.label: Art. 75.1

units.text: In the Russian Federation, conditions are created for sustainable national economic growth, improvement of citizens' well-being and mutual trust between the State and society; protection of citizens' dignity and respect for working people are guaranteed; and a balance of citizens' rights and duties, social partnership, and economic, political and social solidarity are ensured.
units.label: Art. 75.1 · text

units.text: Article 76
units.label: Art. 76

units.text: 1. Federal constitutional laws and federal laws having direct effect throughout the territory of the Russian Federation are adopted on matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 76

units.text: 2. On matters of joint jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and its constituent entities, federal laws are enacted, and laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation are adopted in accordance with them.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 76

units.text: 3. Federal laws may not contradict federal constitutional laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 76

units.text: 4. Outside the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and the joint jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and its constituent entities, republics, territories, regions, cities of federal significance, the autonomous region and autonomous areas exercise their own legal regulation, including adopting laws and other normative legal acts.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 76

units.text: 5. Laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may not contradict federal laws adopted in accordance with parts one and two of this Article. In the event of a conflict between a federal law and another act issued in the Russian Federation, the federal law applies.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 76

units.text: 6. In the event of a conflict between a federal law and a normative legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation issued in accordance with part four of this Article, the normative legal act of the constituent entity applies.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 76

units.text: Article 77
units.label: Art. 77

units.text: 1. The system of bodies of state authority of republics, territories, regions, cities of federal significance, the autonomous region and autonomous areas is established independently by constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with the foundations of the constitutional order of the Russian Federation and the general principles for organizing representative and executive bodies of state authority established by federal law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 77

units.text: 2. Within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and its powers on matters of joint jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and its constituent entities, federal executive bodies and executive bodies of the constituent entities form a unified system of executive authority in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 77

units.text: 3. The highest official of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation (the head of its highest executive body of state authority) may be a citizen of the Russian Federation who has reached 30 years of age, permanently resides in the Russian Federation and holds neither foreign citizenship nor a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen of the Russian Federation's right to permanent residence in a foreign State. In the manner established by federal law, the highest official of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation (the head of its highest executive body of state authority) is prohibited from opening or holding accounts (deposits) or keeping cash and valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation. Federal law may establish additional requirements for the highest official of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation (the head of its highest executive body of state authority).
units.label: Part 3 Art. 77

units.text: Article 78
units.label: Art. 78

units.text: 1. Federal executive bodies may establish their own territorial bodies and appoint the relevant officials to exercise their powers.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 78

units.text: 2. By agreement with executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, federal executive bodies may transfer to them the exercise of some of their powers, provided that this does not contradict the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 78

units.text: 3. Executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may, by agreement with federal executive bodies, transfer to them the exercise of some of their powers.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 78

units.text: 4. The President of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Russian Federation ensure, in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, the exercise of the powers of federal state authority throughout the territory of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 78

units.text: 5. The head of a federal state body may be a citizen of the Russian Federation who has reached 30 years of age and holds neither foreign citizenship nor a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen of the Russian Federation's right to permanent residence in a foreign State. In the manner established by federal law, the head of a federal state body is prohibited from opening or holding accounts (deposits) or keeping cash and valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 78

units.text: Article 79
units.label: Art. 79

units.text: The Russian Federation may participate in interstate associations and transfer some of its powers to them in accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation, provided that this does not restrict human and civil rights and freedoms or contradict the foundations of the constitutional order of the Russian Federation. Decisions of interstate bodies adopted on the basis of provisions of international treaties of the Russian Federation interpreted in a manner contrary to the Constitution of the Russian Federation are not enforceable in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Art. 79 · text

units.text: Article 79.1
units.label: Art. 79.1

units.text: The Russian Federation takes measures to maintain and strengthen international peace and security, ensure the peaceful coexistence of States and peoples and prevent interference in a State's internal affairs.
units.label: Art. 79.1 · text

units.locator: CHAPTER 4. PRESIDENT OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION
units.text: CHAPTER 4. PRESIDENT OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION
units.label: CHAPTER 4. PRESIDENT OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION

units.text: Article 80
units.label: Art. 80

units.text: 1. The President of the Russian Federation is the head of State.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 80

units.text: 2. The President of the Russian Federation is the guarantor of the Constitution of the Russian Federation and of human and civil rights and freedoms. In the manner established by the Constitution of the Russian Federation, the President takes measures to protect the sovereignty, independence and state integrity of the Russian Federation, maintains civil peace and concord in the country and ensures the coordinated functioning and interaction of bodies forming part of the unified system of public authority.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 80

units.text: 3. In accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws, the President of the Russian Federation determines the main directions of the State's domestic and foreign policy.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 80

units.text: 4. As head of State, the President of the Russian Federation represents the Russian Federation within the country and in international relations.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 80

units.text: Article 81
units.label: Art. 81

units.text: 1. The President of the Russian Federation is elected for a term of six years by citizens of the Russian Federation on the basis of universal, equal and direct suffrage by secret ballot.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 81

units.text: 2. A citizen of the Russian Federation aged at least 35, who has permanently resided in the Russian Federation for at least 25 years and does not hold, and has never held, foreign citizenship or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen of the Russian Federation's right to permanent residence in a foreign State, may be elected President of the Russian Federation. The requirement concerning the absence of foreign citizenship for a candidate for President of the Russian Federation does not apply to citizens of the Russian Federation who previously held citizenship of a State that, or part of which, was admitted to the Russian Federation under federal constitutional law and who permanently resided in the territory of the State or part of the State admitted to the Russian Federation. In the manner established by federal law, the President of the Russian Federation is prohibited from opening or holding accounts (deposits) or keeping cash and valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 81

units.text: 3. The same person may not hold the office of President of the Russian Federation for more than two terms.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 81

units.text: 3.1. The provision of part 3 of Article 81 of the Constitution of the Russian Federation limiting the number of terms during which the same person may hold the office of President of the Russian Federation applies to a person who has held and/or holds that office without taking into account the number of terms for which that person has held and/or holds it at the time the constitutional amendment introducing the corresponding limitation enters into force, and does not exclude that person's possibility of holding the office of President of the Russian Federation for the terms permitted by that provision.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 81

units.text: 4. The procedure for electing the President of the Russian Federation is determined by federal law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 81

units.text: Article 82
units.label: Art. 82

units.text: 1. On taking office, the President of the Russian Federation takes the following oath to the people:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 82

units.text: ‘In exercising the powers of President of the Russian Federation, I swear to respect and protect human and civil rights and freedoms, observe and defend the Constitution of the Russian Federation, defend the sovereignty and independence, security and integrity of the State, and faithfully serve the people.’
units.label: Part 1 Art. 82 · “‘In exercising the powers of President of the Russian…”

units.text: 2. The oath is taken in a solemn ceremony in the presence of senators of the Russian Federation, deputies of the State Duma and judges of the Constitutional Court of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 82

units.label: Art. 83
